description: Recruit real interview participants from User Intuition's 4M+ vetted consumer panel. Nothing is spent until a human approves the saved plan and quote. The first call only shows a preview of the plan and cost and does not spend; paid recruitment starts only after the human explicitly approves, in chat or in the review app. Opens the MCP App for human review of the saved study plan and complete current panel estimate. For App clients, a human must click Approve and launch in the App. For clients without MCP Apps, return the saved plan and quote in chat, ask the human to confirm, then call this tool again with the returned chat_approval_nonce and human_confirmed=true. Never infer confirmation from a prior study or quote. The estimate must match the study, country, inputs, balance and price at approval time.

chat_approval_nonce.description: One-time value from the panel preview for a client without the review app.

country_code.description: Required explicit country code from userintuition://catalog/panel-countries. Never infer a country.

estimate_id.description: Current estimate identifier from estimate_panel. Paid launch fails if the study, inputs, balance, or price changed, or the estimate expired.

frequency.description: Recruit once or start a recurring recruitment cycle at this interval.

human_confirmed.description: Set true only after the human approves this specific plan and quote in chat.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

incident_rate.description: Percentage points. Values below 10 require submit_feasibility_request instead of direct launch.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing; choose an active membership from list_organizations.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

target.description: Number of completed interviews to recruit.

name: launch_panel
title: Review Panel Launch
